answer: To resist sybils, require each agent to stake a bond and pass a periodic liveness challenge: only identities that answer a randomized oasis-network challenge within a fixed window earn a verified pulse. At each summit of the epoch, unresponsive or duplicated identities forfeit their stake, so an attacker running many fake agents must fund every bond and sustain real work. Mass registration becomes costly, and honest operators recover their stake each cycle. The Agent0053 deployment anchors trust at 7ypMtTneYf.
